schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 16 reading marking instructions; 17–20 Léamhthuiscint A; 21–24 Léamhthuiscint B; 25 literature notes, the Gaeilge 5 note, the 2A questions and the prose Eolas/Gaeilge table; 26–27 the 2A supporting notes (Cáca Milis, An Lasair Choille); 28 2B and its own band table; 29–32 poetry; 33 Ceist 4 instructions, 4A and the Eolas/Gaeilge table; 34 4B–4E; 35–36 4F; 37 modified marking (SMM). PDF 1–15 belong to Paper 1; 38–39 blank; 40 empty.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 a pointer to the instructions, 3 instructions, 12 blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2018: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. Only A 1(b)(ii) is priced “1 mharc + 1 mharc” and exposes one-mark slots; every (a) part of Q1–5 (2 mharc + 1 mharc) and both 6(a) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) prices two independent six-mark reasons (reason 2 + discussion 4); each half is also a practice slot. B 6(b) is one response priced as the reaction 2 and two points 5 + 5 (as 2021 B 6(b)): three criteria of one part, no slots. Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials, the deficient-answer reduction “(2-1)” of A 4(b)(ii), and the full tariff).

Prose: 2A Cáca Milis and 2A An Lasair Choille are two cards (different printed statements, different Atlas headings); 2B is one card with its two printed alternatives (optional film nó optional play), as decided for every optional film or play. Poetry 3A and 3B and the six Q4 options are one card each; the optional poem or text itself is open content chosen inside one route.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint A 50 and B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 (2A Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille, or 2B); Ceist 3 Filíocht 30 (3A or 3B); Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (one of 4A–4F).
Reading A “Scéalta ó na Daonáirimh” (paper 4–5, scheme PDF 17–20); B “2018 ‐ Ceiliúradh ar an Oidhreacht Chultúrtha agus ar an nGaeilge” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 21–24).

Literature language: 5 marks for Gaeilge in every literature answer (scheme PDF 25); prose 25 Eolas; poetry printed (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 on the paper, assessed as Eolas 13, 5, 7 plus Gaeilge 5 once; Q4 Eolas 35; 4F printed (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10, assessed as Eolas 19, 7, 9 (1 + 4 + 4) plus Gaeilge 5.

Text layer: the 2A questions with their “Eolas = 25 marc” and the prose band table are on PDF 25 and each text’s supporting notes on its own page (26, 27), ending at the panel “Eolas (25) = Gaeilge (5) =”; 2B (PDF 28) prints its question and Treoir, then the marking-panel note and its own band table (worded differently from PDF 25’s); each poem answer ends at the marking-panel note, after which the Gaeilge table (PDF 30, 32) and, on PDF 30, the Marc as 4 table of 3A(ii) are stored; 4F ends at “Ní mór don Scrúdaitheoir an marc ar Eolas as 35 marc …”, after which its Marc as 7 and Marc as 4 tables are stored (PDF 36). The builder returns each table to the sub-question it prices and ends each answer at its note.

Q4A–E print no “Eolas = 35 marc” line of their own: the Ceist 4 Treoracha (“an t-eolas a mharcáil as 35 marc”) and the Eolas (35)/Gaeilge (5) band table on PDF 33 price them, and both are carried on each card. 4A, 4B and 4C print the deficient-answer box “Eolas (35-10) (25) =” for an answer that discusses only one of the required people; it is kept inside the answer as printed.
B 6(b): the scheme prices the reaction and two points as “{2 mharc + 5 mharc + 5 mharc}” (“Tuairim a léiriú = 2 mharc”), not the 6 + 6 halves of A 6(b).
A 4(b)(ii): the scheme prints “mura bhfuil, tá an freagra easnamhach (2-1)”: an incomplete answer earns 1, so the part allows 0, 1 and 2.
No legacy cards exist for 2018 Higher Paper 2: every card is new, with IDs in the 2020–2026 pattern.
